profile.headline: Software Engineer at Boeing Defense, Space & Security, specializing in programming/testing with National Instruments FTMS, LabVIEW, C++, Java, and Python. Key contributor to PAC-3, B-52, and NASA's Space Launch System.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer operating under Boeing’s Defense, Space, and Security Division (BDS) in Advanced Designs and Prototype Solutions (ADaPS).
Programming and testing with National Instruments Test and Measurement Systems (FTMS) along with Labview software for the Patriot Advanced Capability (PAC-3) program.
Operating in a closed area environment requires static eliminating smocks, wristbands, and safety glasses for setting up and testing various parts on the machine.
Setting up and testing various parts and code including low voltage power supply, heater controller, and others on the Interface Test Adapter at the FTMS stations.
Gathered and compiled core team updates from Git and updated the manager with requirements progress. Updating requirements information and providing well-written documentation and tutorials in multiple areas.
Maintained Git wiki information and updated website HTML for software change requests in future releases.
Supported Boeing B-52 Stratofortress program. Provided experience in C++ and Visual Studio with Git version control to update user interface. Familiarity with software change requests and agile processes.
Provided engineering expertise to support the simulation of the Autonomous Flight Safety System (AFSS) Battery Unit (ABU) located within the Space Launch System (SLS) Upper Stage on contract by NASA. Writing and updating code using C++ in Visual Studio and SVN version control, and using Matlab and Simulink to create block structure coding to procedurally simulate battery functions.

positions.title: Student Specialist III in Research Information Systems
positions.description:
Provided IT support to research offices, troubleshooted technical issues, and responded to help desk tickets.
Updated research-related website pages using Joomla, collaborated with research offices to ensure accuracy, and conducted regular website audits.
Used various programming languages, including VB.net, HTML & CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, to develop desktop applications, design website layouts, add interactivity, and create server-side scripts. 
Utilized SQL to design and maintain databases, create queries, and ensure data accuracy and integrity.
